name: ANYbotics ANYmal X
summary: An explosion-proof version of ANYmal, ATEX and IECEx certified up to Zone 1 IIB, for autonomous inspection rounds in chemical and oil and gas plants.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request directly by ANYbotics (Zurich); tested in Ex zones at BASF Ludwigshafen in 2023. No German reseller and no public price.

sellers.name: ANYbotics AG
sellers.note: Sells directly from Zurich; its reseller list names no German partner. Customers in Germany include W.R. Grace (Düren) and BASF (Ludwigshafen tests).

specs.label: Explosion protection
specs.value: ATEX and IECEx up to Zone 1 IIB

specs.label: Normal walking speed
specs.conditions: figure from the 2025 product page; 2026 specifications announced but not yet published

specs.label: Running time
specs.conditions: 60 to 90 min, about 1.5 km per charge (2025 product page)

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 360° lidar, 6 depth cameras, 2 tele-operation cameras; pan-tilt payload with 20x zoom camera, thermal camera -10 to 400 °C, microphone (audible range), spotlight

specs.label: Optional payloads
specs.value: gas sensor payload for combustible and toxic gases

notes: Only legged robot in this list certified for explosive atmospheres (Zone 1 IIB).
Delivered with charger, docking station, Ex-proof tablet and transport box (2025 product page).
Current 2026 specifications were announced as coming soon at the time of checking; weight and payload not published.

evidence.task: Runs 20-minute autonomous visual, thermal and acoustic inspection missions in Ex-zone steamcracker and oxo plants
evidence.note: Part of the BASF legged inspection robot evaluation program.
